page.notes: Page 121. The first word "ardiæ" is a fragment from the previous line and stays as printed. The Roman numeral "M[?]" is printed as "M" followed by a mark I could not identify, so it is marked as doubtful. "quadrienne" in the right-hand margin is set in small italic and is uncertain. A reference mark, a small curved sign, stands before "Ad" in the last line, and a small mark appears at the foot of the page to the left; neither is clearly linked to a printed note, so neither is transcribed. "hæc" at the foot is the catchword, the first word of the following page.
